description: Search Subito.it without a browser, rank ads against the real market, and watch for new listings from cron.

tools.name: ads_check
tools.description: Ask whether a search has new listings since a given listing urn (cheap, no listing data). Required: last. Optional: query, category-id, region-id (plus 2 more). Returns the CheckResult.

params.name: last
params.description: Urn of the newest listing already seen

tools.name: ads_recommended
tools.description: Listings Subito recommends next to one listing (similar items); pass the urn field of a listing from ads search or market deals output. Required: urn. Optional: limit (default: 20). Returns array of Ad.

params.name: urn
params.description: Listing urn (id:ad:<uuid>:list:<list_id>), as returned by ads search

tools.name: ads_search
tools.description: Search listings by keyword, category, place, price and more. Returns newest first by default. Optional: query, category-id, ad-type (default: s) (plus 11 more).

params.name: query
params.description: Keywords (Subito matches loosely and mixes nearby models)

params.name: category-id
params.description: Category id (see 'categories list'), e.g. 2 Auto, 41 Biciclette, 12 Telefonia, 10 Informatica

params.name: ad-type
params.description: Ad type key: s vendita, k cerco, u affitto, h affitto vacanze, g regalo

params.name: province-id
params.description: Province id within the region (see 'geo provinces')

params.name: town-istat
params.description: Town ISTAT code (see 'geo towns'), e.g. 015146 Milano

params.name: shippable
params.description: Only listings that can be shipped (TuttoSubito)

params.name: title-only
params.description: Match keywords in the title only

tools.name: categories_filters
tools.description: Show the search filters a category accepts: query-string key, type and value source. Required: category, ad_type. Returns array of Filter.

params.name: ad_type
params.description: Ad type key (s, k, u, h, g)

tools.name: categories_list
tools.description: List every category with its id and macro-category. Returns array of Value.

tools.name: geo_provinces
tools.description: List the provinces of a region (Subito calls them cities). Required: region. Returns array of Place.

tools.name: geo_regions
tools.description: List the 20 regions with their ids. Returns array of Place.

tools.name: geo_towns
tools.description: List the towns of a province with ISTAT codes and coordinates. Required: region, province. Returns array of Place.

tools.name: values_get
tools.description: Values of one filter list; the path comes from 'categories filters' datasource, without /v1/values/. Required: value_path. Optional: category. Returns the ValueList.

params.name: value_path
params.description: List path, e.g. cars/brands, cars/brands/000083/metamodels, fuels/types, item_condition/types

params.name: category
params.description: Category id some lists require, e.g. 2 for cars

novel_features.name: Deal ranking
novel_features.description: Rank every ad for a search by how far it sits below or above the like-for-like market price.

novel_features.name: Scam signals
novel_features.description: Check one ad for mechanical scam signals with the evidence for each. Photos are not checked and the seller check covers only ads this CLI has already seen, so "ok" is not a clearance.

novel_features.name: Asking-price suggestion
novel_features.description: Get a listing price, a minimum and a quick-sale price from at least five comparable ads (asking prices of private sellers; no price below five comparables).

novel_features.name: Ad timeline
novel_features.description: See when an ad was first seen, every price change, renewals and likely reposts, from what earlier searches and watches recorded locally.
